gloss: to zip up; to do up a zipper

definitions.gloss: to zip up; to close a zipper
definitions.explanation: To close a zipper. チャック is a common everyday word for 'zipper' (originally a brand name).

examples.japanese: チャックを{閉|し}めてください。
ズボンのチャックを{閉|し}め{忘|わす}れた。
examples.english: I forgot to zip up my pants.

examples.japanese: {寒|さむ}かったので、{上着|うわぎ}のチャックを{一番|いちばん}{上|うえ}まで{閉|し}めた。
examples.english: It was cold, so I zipped my jacket all the way up to the top.

notes:
チャック is an everyday word for a zipper (from the brand name 'Chuck'), interchangeable with ファスナー and ジッパー. The opposite action is チャックを{開|あ}ける (to unzip).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- チャックを{開|あ}ける: to unzip
- チャックが{開|あ}いている: your zipper is open (a common gentle warning)
- チャックを{上|あ}げる: to pull the zipper up

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ファスナー: fastener — the more 'official' term for a zipper
- ジッパー: zipper — also common, taken directly from English
